designs.name: Graphit
designs.generation_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final standalone square app icon for EvoRank, a premium strength and progress app. Generate one polished 1024 x 1024 image.
Primary request: an original, unmistakable uppercase E monogram in crisp white on an opaque deep graphite background. This is design option Graphit.
Subject: a bold compact upright E built from a unified geometric shape, three deliberately proportioned horizontal arms and a strong vertical spine. A small precise rectilinear step-cut in the upper arm gives it a memorable proprietary rhythm. The letter must read immediately as E at small icon size. Flat precise modern athletic premium identity with disciplined Swiss graphic design proportions.
Scene/backdrop: edge-to-edge matte graphite near-black, very subtle broad tonal depth, otherwise clean and quiet.
Style/medium: exceptionally clean vector-like graphic design with razor-sharp controlled edges; flat white monogram, no bevel or shiny effects.
Composition/framing: square, centered monogram occupying about 58 percent of the width and height, generous even safe padding for rounded app-icon masks; full opaque background, no inset tile and no drawn rounded-square outline.
Color palette: graphite black and clean white only.
Text: only the custom E monogram, absolutely no brand word, caption, label or slogan.
Constraints: original independent brand identity, deliberately upright and architectural; no aggressive tapered fins, animal heads, sharks, wings, swooshes, teeth, claws, shields, lightning bolts, or similarity to the Gymshark logo. No existing-brand emblems, no phone, device, hand, mockup, border, watermark or surrounding words. The entire image is the usable icon asset.

designs.name: Titan
designs.generation_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final standalone square app icon for EvoRank, a premium strength and progress app. Generate one polished 1024 x 1024 image.
Primary request: an original architectural ER ligature in brushed cool silver on opaque deep black. This is design option Titan.
Subject: a compact custom monogram combining clearly recognizable uppercase E and R, sharing carefully integrated structural geometry. Upright, broad, balanced and engineered. E on the left, R on the right with a squared counter and controlled diagonal leg; one coherent proprietary symbol with intentional open negative spaces. Precise premium industrial architecture, strong legibility at app icon size, no imitation of an existing logo.
Scene/backdrop: edge-to-edge deep black with extremely subtle cool charcoal tonal depth.
Style/medium: front-facing refined metal brand icon, brushed titanium and satin cool silver, shallow sculptural relief with understated polished edge catches. Soft studio light creates gentle material detail without mirror chrome, excessive reflections or dramatic 3D perspective.
Composition/framing: square, the centered ER ligature occupies about 60 percent of the width and 49 percent of the height; generous safe padding for rounded app-icon masks. Entire canvas opaque, no inset tile, badge frame or drawn rounded-square outline.
Color palette: cool silver, graphite and black only; strictly no bright colors or gold.
Text: only the custom ER monogram, absolutely no brand name, caption, label or slogan.
Constraints: unmistakably letter-based independent identity. No animal heads, sharks, fins, wings, swooshes, teeth, claws, shields, lightning bolts, or Gymshark resemblance. No gratuitous diagonal speed slashes, phone, device, hand, product mockup, border or watermark. The entire image is the usable icon asset.
designs.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this square EvoRank Titan app-icon candidate into its production-ready final version.
Preserve the overall silver-and-black premium design, centered architectural ER monogram, brushed cool silver metal material, front-facing view and generous safe padding.
Correct two issues only:
1. Make the full entire square canvas COMPLETELY OPAQUE solid deep black, including every exterior background pixel, every letter counter, and every negative space between strokes. Absolutely no transparency anywhere, no alpha holes. Render the actual black background as part of the image.
2. Rebuild the monogram edges flawlessly clean and smooth, removing every white ragged halo and colored artifact. Clarify the first letter so it reads as an UPRIGHT uppercase E with a vertical stem on its LEFT and three horizontal arms extending RIGHT. Integrate this E with a clearly readable uppercase R to its right; a shared adjacent vertical stroke is acceptable. Do not mirror the E. Maintain the handsome brushed silver treatment with shallow refined bevels.
Composition remains a square standalone usable app icon, metal ER occupies about 60 percent canvas width and about 48 percent height, centered.
No words or labels, no frame, no phone or mockup, no badge outline, no animal, shark, fin, wing, swoosh, or resemblance to Gymshark. Strict cool silver and black palette, no colored lights. No transparency, no white cutout fringe.
